definitions.explanation: Describes something that is extremely strong, powerful, or intense to an overwhelming degree. Used for natural forces, emotions, speed, effort, or opposition.

examples.japanese: {猛烈|もうれつ}な⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いている→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
{猛烈|もうれつ}な⟦{勢|いきお}い→勢い：01782_ikioi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}けた→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
examples.english: I finished the work with furious intensity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{猛烈|もうれつ}な⟦{速|はや}さ→速さ：28072_hayasa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいている→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧。
examples.english: The typhoon is approaching at a tremendous speed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{猛烈|もうれつ}に⟦{反対|はんたい}した→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧。
examples.english: The residents fiercely opposed the plan.

notes:
A strong intensifier that conveys something pushed to an extreme degree. Common in weather reports for the most powerful typhoon category ({猛烈|もうれつ}な⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧), and in business culture for the concept of the ⟦{猛烈|もうれつ}→猛烈：13490_mouretsu⟧⟦サラリーマン→サラリーマン：06084_sarariiman⟧ (fiercely dedicated salaryman of the high-growth era).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {猛烈|もうれつ}な⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧: extremely powerful typhoon
- {猛烈|もうれつ}な⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧: intense heat
- {猛烈|もうれつ}な⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧: fierce opposition
- {猛烈|もうれつ}な⟦{勢|いきお}い→勢い：01782_ikioi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: with tremendous force
- {猛烈|もうれつ}に⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work furiously

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧: intense, violent — broader use, more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{強烈|きょうれつ}→強烈：15109_kyouretsu⟧な: powerful, intense — emphasizes impact on the senses or emotions
- ⟦すさまじい→すさまじい：07674_susamajii⟧: tremendous, terrifying — implies something awe-inspiring or dreadful
